answer: A reef of trust grows only from verified work: each newcomer locks a refundable deposit and completes small tasks checked by randomly assigned peers, earning signed receipts that build a violet-hued reputation ledger no fresh identity can fake. Like a quill signing each receipt, every attestation is hash-chained to the last, so an attacker spawning thousands of throwaway agents must pay a real deposit and do real work for each one, while peers who vouch falsely lose their own stake.
